# Requirements-Quality Checklist: spec 004 Write 阶段

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of spec 004 (write-loop + emit_final_report) before `/speckit-implement`. Tests whether the spec is well-written, complete, unambiguous, and ready for implementation — NOT whether the implementation works.

**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](./../spec.md) · [plan.md](./../plan.md) · [data-model.md](./../data-model.md) · [contracts/README.md](./../contracts/README.md) · [tasks.md](./../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does NOT mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus areas** (derived from spec 004 domain signals — "write-loop", "outline/draft/critic/polish", "emit_final_report", "LangGraph 1.2 sub-graph", "Langfuse prompt", "Pydantic schema upgrade"):
1. Requirement Clarity & Completeness (FR-001 ~ FR-020)
2. Acceptance Criteria Quality (SC-001 ~ SC-010)
3. Edge Case Coverage (9 explicit edge cases)
4. Spec/Plan/Constitution Alignment (7 Clarifications + Constraint #1 PARTIAL)

**Audience**: PR Reviewer (pre-merge gate for spec 004 to enter `/speckit-implement`)
**Depth**: Standard (~30-40 items, prioritized by risk/impact)

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 5 user stories (US1-US5) complete with explicit **acceptance scenarios** that enumerate Given/When/Then? [Completeness, Spec §US1-US5]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec cover the full **write sub-graph topology** (4 internal nodes + 1 outer emit node) without gaps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006 + FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all 4 new Langfuse prompts (`deep-research-outline` / `-draft` / `-critic` / `-polish`) enumerated with their **required placeholders** and **output schema**? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010 + C9]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the **4 LLM roles** (`write` / `draft` / `critic` / `polish`) and their temperatures specified for every write stage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012 + C1]
- [ ] CHK005 Are both **write-loop termination conditions** (`critic_score >= 0.8` AND `iteration_counts["write"] >= 2`) explicitly OR'd per WriteTerminationPolicy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005 + §6 Policies]
- [ ] CHK006 Are **both** state field writers (state["draft"] by `_draft_node` overwrite by `_polish_node`) and read-only consumers explicitly declared for every write sub-graph node? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-004 + data-model.md §3 State field 写入者矩阵]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the term "**h2 章节**" in US1 quantified with an explicit regex (`re.findall(r'^## ', outline, re.MULTILINE)`) so implementation cannot misinterpret? [Clarity, Spec §US1 + SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the **`{{cite_N}}` placeholder syntax** unambiguously specified (regex, allowed N range, fallback for unmapped N)? [Clarity, Spec §US2 acceptance 2 + FR-007 + R2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the **JSON parsing of critic output** unambiguous about: (a) markdown fence stripping, (b) `model_validate_json` vs `model_validate`, (c) `ValidationError` retry policy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003 + §Edge Cases · JSON fence]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the **`polish` philosophy** ("尽力改进", allow empty draft, allow 50%+ reduction) explicitly stated as a **silent degrade** exception to the standard error propagation contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017 + R7 + Constraint #4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the **`Source.index` duplicate defense** in `_emit_final_report_node` unambiguous (enumerate reindex from 1, or skip duplicates, or both)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008 + R6 + US5 acceptance 3]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the **counter `+1` discipline** explicitly stated as "at node entry, NOT at conditional-edge decision point" so implementation cannot put `+1` in the wrong place? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003 + Q5 + Constraint #3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the 7 Clarifications (Q1-Q7) **align** with the corresponding FR (Q1 → FR-010, Q2 → FR-012, Q3 → FR-007, Q4 → FR-014, Q5 → FR-003, Q6 → FR-009, Q7 → FR-008)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications + §FR]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the spec state **`emit_final_report` is outer-graph** (per Q6) consistently in: spec.md Clarifications, spec.md FR-009, plan.md §实现路径, contracts C8? [Consistency, Spec §Q6 + FR-009 + plan.md §3 + C8]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the **Critique schema upgrade** (add `suggestions: list[str]`) consistently described in: spec.md Q4, spec.md FR-014, data-model.md §4, contracts C11, plan.md §Complexity Tracking? [Consistency, Spec §Q4 + FR-014 + data-model §4 + C11 + plan §CT]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the **backward-compatibility claim** for `Critique.suggestions` (`default_factory=list`, old instances `suggestions=[]`) consistent between Complexity Tracking and data-model.md §4? [Consistency, plan.md §CT + data-model.md §4]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the spec treat `iteration_counts["write"]` as a **shared field** (spec 001 init 0, spec 004 writes via critic_review +1) consistently without contradicting spec 002/003's `iteration_counts["research"]`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003 + spec 003 §Q4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are all 10 SC **objectively measurable** (single Python one-liner + assert) without requiring subjective reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 ~ SC-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the **expected outputs of SC-001** stated as concrete tuples / booleans (e.g., `(True, True, True, True)`) so the smoke test prints a deterministic verdict? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the **threshold values** in SC-005 (`iteration_counts["write"] ∈ {1, 2}`) and SC-006 (`[ref_N] count >= len(state["sources"])`) consistent with FR-005 (WriteTerminationPolicy)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-005/006 + FR-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the **"## References" Markdown format** (per ReferenceListPolicy in CONTEXT.md §6) cross-referenced so SC-006/007 can validate exact format? [Traceability, Spec §SC-006/007 + FR-007 + CONTEXT.md §6]
- [ ] CHK022 Does SC-009's "**delete prompt from Langfuse then run SC-001**" test path require a deterministic cleanup-then-recreate workflow (or is the test re-creatable without manual Langfuse UI interaction)? [Testability, Spec §SC-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is the **happy path** (full write-loop completion: outline → draft → critic → polish → critic → end → emit) covered as the primary success scenario with end-to-end SC? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001 + SC-008]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the **early-termination path** (critic score >= 0.8 on first try, no polish needed) explicitly covered as an alternate scenario? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005 + §4]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the **max-iteration path** (counter reaches 2, force exit regardless of score) explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005 + §Edge Cases · counter +1]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the **error-recovery path** (Langfuse prompt missing → NotYetImplementedError; JSON parse fail → retry 1) covered as exception flow? [Coverage, Spec §US1 scenario 3 + US3 scenario 2 + FR-018]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are all **9 explicit edge cases** (outline 章节数 / draft 跳过占位符 / critic score 越界 / JSON fence / polish 大幅缩减 / `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` 缺失 / counter +1 时机 / emit sources 为空 / Source.url 非法) covered as requirements with expected behavior? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the **polish empty-draft** edge case explicitly stated as "allowed" (not "fallback to original draft") — i.e., spec deliberately accepts LLM erasing draft? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017 + R7]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the **`{{cite_N}}` where N > len(sources)** edge case (per [Q3] "dropped, not throwing") explicitly stated in the requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007 + R2]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the **Langfuse chat prompt with embedded code-fence in critic output** edge case explicitly covered (strip before `model_validate_json`)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases · JSON fence + FR-003]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the **Source.url Pydantic HttpUrl validation** spec'd to happen at Pydantic schema entry (not at emit time) so emit can trust the URL is valid? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases · Source.url 非法 + spec 001 schema]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Is the **P50/P90 wall-clock latency** (NFR-001) quantified for write sub-graph end-to-end (60s P50 / 120s P90) with explicit LLM call budget (6 calls)? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-001]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the **`iteration_counts` increment discipline** (NFR-002) stated as a non-negotiable invariant with a specific test point (at `_critic_review_node` entry, NOT in conditional edge)? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-002 + Constraint #3]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the **prompt-text-never-in-source** invariant (NFR-003) cross-checked against contracts C9 to confirm 4 prompts have no Python string literals? [Traceability, Spec §NFR-003 + C9]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the **silent-fallback prohibition** (NFR-004) stated as "抛真实异常" for write nodes EXCEPT polish, so implementation cannot accidentally swallow errors? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-004 + FR-017 + Constraint #4]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Are the 4 external **dependencies** (Postgres / Langfuse / DashScope / LangGraph 1.2.11+) all stated with their **version or service** rather than just "must be available"? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the **spec 001/002/003 inherited guarantees** (e.g., Source.index 1..N global uniqueness per spec 003 Q6) cited as **assumptions** the write spec relies on? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions + spec 003 Q6]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the **out-of-scope items** (Streamlit UI / Langfuse hooks / multi-model ensemble / multimodal / language switching / per-source excerpt / etc.) enumerated explicitly per §Out of Scope? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK039 Does the spec avoid [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers — all 7 Q1-Q7 decisions resolved inline? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the **MINOR Critique schema upgrade** (add `suggestions`) explicitly justified in plan.md §Complexity Tracking with **why not a new state field** and **why not a MAJOR version bump**? [Traceability, plan.md §CT + Constraint #1 PARTIAL]
- [ ] CHK041 Are there any **conflicts** between the spec, plan, data-model, and contracts? (e.g., FR-007 says `re.sub` but data-model.md §6 might describe it differently) [Conflict, cross-doc review]
- [ ] CHK042 Are the **completion-state differences** (spec 003 vs spec 004) tabulated in plan.md §完成态对比 so reviewers can see what's expected to change? [Traceability, plan.md §完成态对比]
